links.outcome: Model performance on random versus difficulty-balanced representative test sets
links.effect: YOLOv11 precision fell from 0.95 in the random test set to 0.83 in the balanced set with more challenging cases; recall, accuracy, and F1 showed similar declines across all model variants.
links.quote: For example, the precision for YOLOv11 models decreased from 0.95 in the random set to 0.83 in the balanced set.

unlisted_practices: Constructing test sets balanced by case difficulty, projection type, and fracture presence to avoid performance overestimation

screen.reason: Empirical study investigating how validation/test set design choices (stratified/balanced for difficulty vs random) impact evaluation performance metrics to avoid overestimation before deployment.
